peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: Longer-term assessment from the same dashboard peg block and referenced history. All 717 retained observations are below par; 7-day mean $0.995792 and retained-month mean $0.995599. Five reported October 3 observations are below $0.99; pool-derived historical marks are not independently reconstructed fills. crvUSD-derived CDP/PegKeeper design without collateral redemption; HEC/LEC economics respond to price, FIR is fixed-rate. Short operating history and persistent discount limit confidence. Held at 5.0; a spot tick alone is not a reassessment.

backing.backing_score_basis: Real borrower overcollateralization, with shared-history mean conservative CR 129.10% over 7 days versus 130.45% over the retained month; no sampled bad debt. Recent softer CR warrants attention, not an extrapolated long-term decline. Recursive LP collateral and narrow liquidation margins remain structural constraints. Inclusive CR includes LP-owned pool inventory and is not borrower coverage. No market-headroom history is available, so dated headroom buckets are not presented as long-term averages. Held at 5.0.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — collateral composition, though the ratio itself is spot-responsive
backing.backing_score_denominator: ✅ ASK WHAT THE RATIO DIVIDES BY — and here the answer is the good one: borrower collateral over borrower debt, two independently determined quantities. Contrast usdat, susds and the syrup pools, where backing is DEFINED as the supply and the ratio is an accounting identity.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: Longer-term assessment using the exact DexTracker source and definitions consumed by the dashboard. Limited venue diversity and large-size price impact constrain exits despite low small-trade impact. Shared-history counter-inventory averages $909,580 over 7 days and $872,047 over the retained month, with a sharp contraction in the reported October 3 stress episode. Inventory is context, not executable depth. Only one comparable DexTracker ladder snapshot is archived: no depth trend or average is established. Same market-sizing anchor, inventory-proportional split and slippage_bps_debiased; the dated numerical ladder is supporting evidence. The standing par discount belongs on Peg. Held at 3.0; improvement requires repeated comparable depth evidence.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: Reassess on material deterioration in shared 50-bps depth or published impact rungs, reduced exit inventory or changing venue structure. Peg deviation is assessed on axis 1.
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: Same published DexTracker rungs and slippage_bps_debiased as dashboard. USD sizes at dated market mark; added impact relative to $100 baseline; inventory-proportional allocation. Output stables at $1, quotes include fees and exclude gas. No independent replacement ladder.
liquidity.liquidity_score_band_divergence: Dashboard band and report score share the exact DexTracker measurement. Authored 3.0 additionally interprets venue concentration and the shape of the published impact curve; it is not a substitute calculation of market depth.
liquidity.liquidity_score_ladder: $1,000: 0.05 bps added impact, 4.94 bps total market-value cost; $10,000: 0.60 bps added impact, 5.48 bps total market-value cost; $100,000: 6.64 bps added impact, 11.53 bps total market-value cost; $1,000,000: 1252.56 bps added impact, 1257.44 bps total market-value cost

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: Persistent layered exposure through market contracts, StakeDAO/Convex/gauge wrappers, Curve LPs and constituent issuers. Resupply reUSD remains a recursive dependency at roughly one-fifth of debt in dated October observations, not a measured monthly average. Minimum-price collateral marking limits pair diversification. The weakest-exotic historical field does not identify the same constituent in every sample. No continuous composition/headroom history is available. Idle additions add no current debt exposure. Held at 4.0.
dependencies.underlying_score_persistence: filtered — book composition, not a daily balance

issuer.issuer_score_basis: Small issuer, beta product and short operating record. Supply stays below $5M throughout retained dashboard history; the latest-week average is below the retained-month average. Historical audit coverage is recorded, while per-finding remediation and current token-governance status remain unverified. October governance/audit retrievals supplied insufficient content; absence of retrieved content does not establish absence of governance or audits. Administrative powers are scored on Contract & Admin. Held at 4.0.

routing_note: The reviewed dashboard registers all six axis overlays. Source precedence and report interpretation are documented in specs/usg-shared-evidence.md. The dated saved payloads are evidence, not a live deployment verification.

report_evidence_policy.method: arithmetic means of available samples; counts are observations, not exact time at a level
report_evidence_policy.liquidity_history_limit: one comparable canonical ladder snapshot; no depth trend established
report_evidence_policy.rule: dashboard and report share evidence and definitions; report scores assess sustained or structural conditions
